body:
```

Build type: RelWithDebInfo

```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/be5167e21cfbb5d566c09a67c1852d0e18c62c38) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: Terax v0.9.0
body:
Terax 0.9.0 introduces a new Ghostty-powered + WebGPU terminal and a broad pass on responsiveness and resource use.

- Lower idle CPU use and less memory growth when switching tabs, desktops, and windows.
- Smoother window and split resizing, with fewer redraw artifacts and duplicated prompts.
- Pixel-aligned text and seamless box-drawing, braille, and Powerline glyphs.
- More efficient terminal output, background tasks, file watching, and startup loading.
- More reliable AI conversation storage and cancellation, plus security hardening around terminal transport and network requests.
- Explorer file paste from the OS clipboard, multi-select operations, and faster file search.
- Bundled CLI file opening, nested-repository Git support, editor shortcut improvements, and refined agent notifications and window styling.

Downloads include macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows, and Linux packages. Windows installations without WebView2 need an internet connection to install its runtime.

name: v0.8.164
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.164

Released on 2026-10-16.

Website capture only connects to public addresses, including after a redirect. Audio tracks keep the mix order you wrote, and ffmpeg failures keep the line that explains why.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Pin website capture connections to public peers ([8be76fc86cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8be76fc86cda5b2a77d0ee23b65f582e85376042), [#5668](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5668)).
- **Producer:** An ffmpeg failure names how ffmpeg ended and keeps its last line ([c03532b285b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c03532b285b00ce2e82900bc80a10cd1fb4c470b), [#5678](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5678)).
- **Engine:** Preserve authored audio mix order ([8e17ee9300f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8e17ee9300f0142d7c01f5a670c5ed3950ceed1e), [#5672](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5672)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.163...v0.8.164

name: v0.8.163
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.163

Released on 2026-10-16.

Website captures keep inline SVG logos whole, and timed SVG clips hide outside their window. Publishing now asks you to log in when it needs an account.

## Features

- **CLI:** Judge text behind a transparent video by its decoded alpha in check ([cea8aa8a7de](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cea8aa8a7dee9d669e47e4b488213008bbe305cd), [#5657](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5657)).
- **CLI:** Render telemetry reports how busy the machine's CPU was ([0e9f380c2e2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0e9f380c2e2295db4b88945a77cfa81001ac5c27), [#5646](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5646)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Ask to log in when publishing needs an account ([917ee5d3134](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/917ee5d31342f8c8a4a14659679762489cafe665), [#5670](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5670)).
- **Core:** Timed svg clips hide outside their window ([1ee6754f710](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1ee6754f7106335cc5533f7205bd3b7949ddb887), [#5661](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5661)).
- **CLI:** Capture writes inline SVG logos whole and parakeet takes long audio ([0d6bdd453bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0d6bdd453bbcfae2280cf2b66f0b6b5afccc10ba), [#5662](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5662)).
- **CLI:** Skip runtime by-products when fingerprinting a skill bundle ([08ee1bd5ad5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/08ee1bd5ad59987a7f2525222683e24ca30971f9), [#5654](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5654)).

## Internal

- **Studio:** Re-run an edit accuracy shard on a fresh runner when its runner is too slow ([a403ea1e8b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a403ea1e8b283c6bdcbe21b5cab2a2a50b5f35f3), [#5659](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5659)).

name: v5.3.0
body:
Ponytail 5.3 puts a band above the Claude Code prompt: what the current task costs, its tokens and agent time, how much existing code it reused, and whether the tests still pass. One click opens the board, a local page with every task across your projects and a card to share. Everything stays on your machine by default, `/ponytail band` hides it, and it needs Claude Code 2.1.290 or later.

![The ponytail band in Claude Code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/v5.3.0/assets/band/band.png)


## What's Changed
* fix(qoder): keep the ruleset on the /ponytail default turn by @htjworld in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1115
* fix(hermes): send the off notice after /ponytail off (#1121) by @szsunyuan in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1122

name: v18.11.1
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- `Tokenizer.countLatestTurn`: counts a message as the transcript's latest assistant turn, which an Anthropic Messages replay keeps byte-for-byte ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `Agent.prioritizeSteering`: moves given pending steering messages ahead of older ones so one-at-a-time delivery takes them first ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642))

### Fixed

- Fixed a Cursor tool call re-sent by the server persisting two results under one id; the re-run's result replaces the first ([#15749](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15749))
- Fixed compaction keeping more recent history than `keepRecentTokens` when the latest Claude turn on the Anthropic Messages API ended its tool calls on `stop` or `length`: the replay keeps that turn's signed reasoning, but the cut point counted only its visible blocks ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added image support for native OpenAI Decisions and Workers AI judgments, prompted vision chat, and auth-gateway System One requests; images exceeding a judgment API's documented caps (e.g. Clef's 4 images, 4 MiB each) are rejected locally ([#15471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15471) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- `isSurvivingAssistant` in `providers/transform-messages`: whether an assistant turn reaches a replay, malformed tool calls dropped first, so callers outside `transformMessages` pick the same latest turn ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed Codex-hosted image generation ignoring the requested `aspect_ratio`/`image_size`, and `3:2`/`2:3` requests sending no size to OpenAI image models ([#15601](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15601) by [@chulmin-dev](https://github.com/chulmin-dev))
- Fixed Claude subagents failing to return structured results when `yield` arguments arrived as invalid JSON ([#15605](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15605) by [@farnoy](https://github.com/farnoy))
- Fixed turns stopping instead of retrying when a gateway reports its upstream WebSocket closed before `response.completed` ([#15628](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15628) by [@nqrwhal](https://github.com/nqrwhal)).
- Fixed Claude on Google Vertex ignoring `cacheRetention: "long"`: prompt caches now get the 1h TTL instead of expiring after 5 minutes, and the `extended-cache-ttl` beta (which Vertex rejects) is never sent there ([#15505](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15505) by [@hpost](https://github.com/hpost))
- Fixed Gemini tool continuations failing on OpenAI-compatible gateways that return `reasoning_signature`, including restored sessions ([#15678](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15678) by [@Zzz141592653](https://github.com/Zzz141592653))
- Fixed Cursor sessions failing every rebuilt request with `PROVIDER_ERROR` after the server re-sent a tool call: the call is recorded once, and histories that already repeat it replay it once with its latest result ([#15749](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15749))
- Fixed Cursor turns cut off mid-stream failing every retry with `PROVIDER_ERROR` until you sent a new message; the retry now starts a fresh Cursor conversation ([#15830](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15830))
- Fixed malformed image-generation inputs being forwarded to providers or reported as credential/upstream errors ([#15765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15765) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Fixed broker-backed auth-gateway processes retaining a cache entry for every distinct client session indefinitely under sustained traffic ([#15841](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15841)).
- Fixed turns ending on a pinned error when a provider reports "temporarily unavailable" or finishes with an `unknown`, `other` or `unspecified` finish reason: these now retry automatically ([#15424](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15424) by [@lockwo](https://github.com/lockwo))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- Enabled long prompt-cache retention (`ttl: "1h"`) for Claude models on `google-vertex` ([#15505](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15505) by [@hpost](https://github.com/hpost))
- Fixed Gemini 4 Argon on Google Vertex and the Gemini API failing every request with "Thinking budget is not supported for this model": Gemini 4 now sends `thinkingLevel` instead of `thinkingBudget`, and Argon offers only the low, medium, and high levels Google accepts ([#15643](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15643) by [@kevcube](https://github.com/kevcube))
- Fixed the Antigravity model selector offering roster rows the backend marks disabled (`disabled: true`, e.g. `gemini-4-argon-disabled` on accounts without Argon access), which answered `Cloud Code Assist API error (404): Requested entity was not found.`; discovery now skips them the way it already skips `isInternal` rows ([#15684](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15684) by [@CharleoYang](https://github.com/CharleoYang))
- Removed Google Antigravity's Gemini 3.5 Flash and its `gemini-3-flash` alias from the model list; Antigravity retired them and answers every request with a retirement notice instead of a reply ([#15445](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15445) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `xai-oauth` Grok 4.20 models (`grok-4.20-0309-reasoning`, `-non-reasoning`, `grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309`) advertising a 2M context window when the SuperGrok API rejects prompts over 1M; auto-compaction and context usage now work from the 1M window ([#15443](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15443) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed trailing-dot `localhost.` and `*.local.` custom endpoints losing local-backend compatibility settings ([#15798](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15798)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added image attachments to single and batch eval `judge()`/`judge_batch()` calls (local paths or embedded images); image judgments skip candidates without image support and fail explicitly instead of dropping images ([#15471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15471) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))
- Added a job tree to `/jobs`, `/jobs full` and the jobs pill's sheet, in the terminal UI and over ACP: subagents' background jobs now appear nested under the task that runs them, with the busiest branches listed first; only your own jobs offer Cancel ([#15854](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15854) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Added `ctx.ui.getEditorComponent()` so extensions can wrap the active custom editor factory instead of replacing it ([#8655](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/8655) by [@jovi-tsx](https://github.com/jovi-tsx))

### Changed

- Reduced memory used by bundled model catalog data in standalone and npm installs ([#15876](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15876) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

### Fixed

- Fixed `/shake` and automatic shake leaving old transcript rows in native scrollback or obscuring the start of a response beside the Todo HUD ([#15877](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15877)).
- Fixed `write` making Rust source files beginning with `#![...]` executable instead of preserving their permissions ([#15858](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15858)).
- Fixed the startup status bar preview showing a previous session's model instead of the default model ([#15865](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15865)).
- Fixed `length`-stop recovery with a lowered `compaction.thresholdTokens` counting the discarded output against the threshold, so a reasoning-only cut compacted without the retry hint and a truncated answer was discarded instead of kept ([#15870](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15870))
- Fixed `read` on a directory showing `(empty directory)` when the directory itself is unreadable, and silently omitting subdirectories it cannot list; it now errors for an unreadable root and marks unreadable subdirectories `[unreadable: …]` ([#15769](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15769)).
- Fixed isolated tasks losing the commits of a submodule added inside the isolation, leaving the merged checkout pinned to an unreachable commit ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed isolated task startup hanging or detaching an unrelated checkout when `.gitmodules` lists a submodule path that is absolute or contains `.`/`..` ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `/live` and Ctrl+L starting live mode while the composer microphone was still loading its recognizer, which opened a second recorder and dictated into the hidden editor ([#15759](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15759))
- Fixed images in the transcript not opening their file; their placeholders and image chips now link to it ([#15872](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15872) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed print mode returning success after length-stop recovery gave up; it now waits for the session to settle before choosing its exit code ([#15732](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15732) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight))
- Fixed browser `tab.click("text/…")` passing over a match a scroll container shows only a narrow strip of and clicking a later duplicate instead ([#15792](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15792) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `/advisor` status waiting on usage checks; it now renders immediately with cached quota data and refreshes usage in the background ([#15780](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15780) by [@mvid](https://github.com/mvid))
- Fixed task agents silently skipping `autoload-skills` entries for skills added after the session started ([#15723](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15723) by [@shyamsivakumar](https://github.com/shyamsivakumar))
- Fixed changed `initOptions` in `lsp.json` not applying when a new session reused an idle shared language server ([#15645](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15645) by [@mottopanikeiku](https://github.com/mottopanikeiku); [#15535](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15535))
- Fixed wake completions falsely reporting no output when the agent already messaged its owner over IRC ([#15834](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15834) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg)).
- Fixed a steered service readiness wait leaving the daemon broker polling until `ready.timeout`; the abandoned wait is now cancelled ([#15656](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15656))
- Fixed Cursor `;`-separated reads returning an image part's bytes as text ([#15635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15635))
- Fixed auto-compaction ignoring `retry.waitForUsageReset` and abandoning the last compaction method on a provider-stated usage-limit reset past `retry.maxDelayMs` ([#15313](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15313))
- Fixed advisor compaction dropping the kept latest turn when the native compaction had to stop before it ([#15712](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15712))
- Fixed tool-approval steering: a message typed while viewing a subagent now steers the main session awaiting the approval, the message that denied a call is delivered ahead of older queued steers, and an equal-looking later steer no longer answers a new approval ([#15642](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15642))
- Fixed workpool item errors cancelling the entire batch; workers now continue with remaining items and report each result separately ([#15860](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15860)).
- Fixed image attachments with uppercase MIME types being dropped; supported image MIME types are now matched case-insensitively ([#15765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15765) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))
- Fixed ordinary Bash commands emitting an ignored-readiness warning for placeholder-only `ready` fields, while preserving warnings for log/port conditions and service validation ([#15629](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15629) by [@nqrwhal](https://github.com/nqrwhal)).
- `openai-models-list` discovery reads the output limit from `top_provider.max_completion_tokens` (OpenRouter-shaped catalogs such as ModelRelay), so a bundled reference with a larger limit no longer makes requests the provider rejects ([#15652](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15652) by [@shanev](https://github.com/shanev))
- Fixed saved session history being replaced by incomplete rewrites after asynchronous disk write failures ([#15588](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15588) by [@jiwangyihao](https://github.com/jiwangyihao)).
- Fixed the `read` tool description inviting `:img` on PNG paths: it now says `:img` only rasterizes SVG/SVGZ files and raster images need no selector, and the `:img` error on a raster file says to read it without the selector ([#15671](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15671) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight))
- Corrected the `ast_grep` truncated-result advice to suggest `skip` pagination or narrowing instead of `increase limit`, which the tool schema does not accept ([#15532](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15532), [#15543](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15543) by [@peda-cos](https://github.com/peda-cos)).
- Fixed Cursor sessions with many MCP tools compacting unnecessarily or pausing automatic maintenance despite ample free context ([#15815](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15815)).
- Fixed switching a session or advisor to Cursor still counting the previous model's tool schemas toward context usage and compaction ([#15815](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15815)).
- Fixed todo reminders continuing the agent when the `todo` tool is disabled ([#12589](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12589) by [@anthonyrisinger](https://github.com/anthonyrisinger)).
- Fixed JS eval `completion()` handles created in one cell never resolving in a later cell, which left `wait(handles, { timeout })` hanging past its timeout ([#15756](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15756)).
- Closed `read :raw` line ranges now return only the requested content, and newline-terminated files report their actual line count ([#15810](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15810)).
- Fixed `/review` PR file assignments by including exact per-file diff URLs and preserving 1-based indexes across excluded files ([#15463](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15463) by [@tkossak](https://github.com/tkossak))
- Fixed `grep` and `ast_grep` returning no matches for a `path` glob that names directories, such as `src/{api,web}` or `src/we?`; matched directories are now searched recursively like a plain directory path, so `src/*` also searches files in `src`'s subdirectories ([#15760](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15760))
- Fixed a structured `display()` value in an Eval cell appearing twice in the TUI and collab view, as text in the cell box and again as the JSON tree; it now shows once, as the tree, while the model still sees the text ([#10778](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10778), [#12730](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12730) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- `omp auth-gateway serve` now bounds its broker-backed session cache instead of growing with every distinct client session ([#15841](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15841)).
- Fixed the run ending when a reasoning model stops with only a signed thinking block and no reasoning text (seen with Gemini 4 via OpenRouter); the agent now continues it like any other thinking-only stop ([#15837](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15837))
- Fixed `openai-models-list` discovery ignoring a model's top-level `max_output_tokens` / `max_completion_tokens`, which let gateway models inherit an output cap as large as the whole context window and send oversized `max_completion_tokens` ([#15811](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15811))
- Fixed the standalone binary crashing with `Settings not initialized` when resuming or starting a TUI session with an extension whose dependencies clear `require.cache` (e.g. `request-promise` via `pi-messenger-bridge`) ([#15799](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15799))
- Python Eval displays preserve integers outside JavaScript's safe range as decimal strings in structured JSON instead of silently rounding them ([#15847](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15847)).
- Loop-watchdog stalls while Mnemopi truncates the recall query for compaction or background first-turn recall are now logged under `mnemopi.recall` instead of `unknown` ([#15413](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15413) by [@jaredlyon](https://github.com/jaredlyon)).
- Clarified the `/session pin` description: it pins a stored OAuth account to the current provider for this session only ([#15479](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15479) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed `/jobs` doing nothing in a focused subagent view: it now lists that subagent's own background jobs, as does the jobs pill's sheet, without a way to cancel them; `/jobs kill` still requires returning to the main session ([#15161](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15161) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed a suspended JavaScript Eval cell resolving `artifact://` and `local://` paths against the session directories of another cell that started while it was awaiting ([#15409](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15409) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `read` ignoring JSON and JSONL `?q=` filters and pagination for `local://` and `artifact://` files ([#15767](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15767)).
- Agents can now read saved context notes without accidentally clearing them ([#15748](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15748) by [@Komzpa](https://github.com/Komzpa))
- Fixed startup without an explicit model picking an unrelated authenticated provider instead of the first available model in the configured default fallback chain ([#15781](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15781) by [@mvid](https://github.com/mvid))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed a failing `mnemopi` CLI command or MCP memory call dropping the embeddings of memories it had just stored ([#15804](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15804) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `listWorkspace({ reportDirectoryErrors })`: an unreadable root fails the scan and unreadable subdirectories are returned in `unreadableDirectories` instead of being silently skipped ([#15769](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15769)).

### Fixed

- Fixed unnecessary worker scheduling overhead in `read` loops over regular files ([#15504](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15504) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg))
- Fixed `astGrep` and `astEdit` missing parse errors when Tree-sitter recovered by inserting a missing token, so edits could rewrite files that do not parse; such files are now reported and skipped ([#15530](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15530), [#15851](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15851) by [@glyahh](https://github.com/glyahh))
- Fixed `grep` and `astGrep` `glob` filters skipping the files under a directory the glob matches, so `{src,test}` or `sr?` found nothing; a matched directory now selects every file under it, so `dir/*` also matches files in `dir`'s subdirectories ([#15760](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15760))
- Fixed `grep()` and `search()` showing the start of a line wider than `maxColumns`, with no `column`, when the only match was an empty one at the end of the file (`$` or `\z` on a last line without a newline); they now show the end of the line and its column ([#15411](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15411) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed embedded-shell `xargs` failing with "Argument list too long" on large input lists instead of splitting them into executable batches ([#15708](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15708) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg))
- Fixed applying a submodule pin patch to the worktree failing with "does not exist" for a submodule directory or trying to write the pinned commit as a file; like `git apply`, the submodule's checkout is left untouched, an added pin creates its empty directory, and a removed one deletes only an empty (uninitialized) directory ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `diffText`/`numstat` showing a moved submodule as a delete plus an add instead of Git's 100% rename, and `applyPatch` now applies such rename patches ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `submodulePaths()` following `.gitmodules` paths that are absolute or contain `.`/`..`, which could point outside the repository or loop forever; like Git, such entries are ignored ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed `copyGitObjects` exposing partially copied objects and packs to concurrent Git readers and permanently skipping a file truncated by an interrupted copy; each file is now published atomically ([#15459](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15459))
- Fixed embedded-shell `read` in a pipeline stage or async job queueing a second blocking worker while holding its own, which could hang every such read once the bounded blocking pool filled ([#15509](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15509))
- Fixed Mermaid labels decoding legacy references such as `€` or `#150;` to invisible C1 controls instead of the browser's `€` and `–` ([#15621](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15621))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added a tree layout to the background jobs sheet: subagents' jobs nest under the task job that runs them, busiest branches first, and Cancel appears only on the viewing agent's own jobs ([#15854](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15854) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed transcript images not opening their file: image placeholders and native image nodes now link to the source file or a stored copy ([#15872](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15872) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- A collapsing live block no longer leaves its slack as a band of blank rows between the retired history and the live rows: the slack falls below the transcript, so a streamed reply stays contiguous and the input keeps the bottom row ([#15499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15499) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed width-aware text on native (TSP) terminals truncating content two columns early ([#15806](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15806) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed Tab/right-arrow completion silently dismissing a selected `@"quoted path"` file suggestion when the path contains spaces ([#15698](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15698) by [@drawde-nadroj](https://github.com/drawde-nadroj))
- Bracketed pastes are now capped by their UTF-8 size, so a large multibyte paste no longer buffers past the byte limit ([#15803](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15803) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed OSC 66 text-sized spans bypassing truncation when their UTF-16 length was short enough to fit the fast-path guard ([#15802](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15802) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Updated the `ast_grep` result view's truncated-match note to suggest `skip` pagination instead of the schema's nonexistent `increase limit` flag ([#15532](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15532), [#15543](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15543) by [@peda-cos](https://github.com/peda-cos)).
- Fixed a streaming Edit preview with long wrapped lines growing past its row cap, because its tail was budgeted without the diff gutter its continuation rows hang under ([#15679](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15679))
- Fixed malformed base64 padding being accepted for chat image attachments before native image decoding ([#15765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15765) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- Fixed Shift+Enter submitting and Ctrl+Enter inserting a newline in Windows Terminal 1.25–1.27 after closing any fullscreen view such as `/settings`; the terminal dropped omp's keyboard mode on leaving the alternate screen ([microsoft/terminal#20763](https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/issues/20763)), so omp now re-applies it ([#15868](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15868) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Long lines in native (Tern) `read`, `write`, and code-cell source now wrap instead of scrolling each block sideways ([#15823](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15823)).
- Fixed long text pastes taking seconds to land in terminals that deliver a paste one key at a time, such as JetBrains' terminal on Windows; omp no longer writes to the terminal for every pasted key ([#15757](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15757))
- Fixed Shift+Enter submitting the prompt and Ctrl+Enter inserting a newline in WSL under Windows Terminal 1.24 and earlier, conhost, and other ConPTY hosts without kitty keyboard support; Shift+Enter now inserts a newline and Ctrl+Enter sends a follow-up, as on native Windows.
- Fixed streamed Markdown tables jumping around as each row arrives: the terminal UI fills the row being written in under the existing column widths, and native (TSP) terminals receive each row once its line is complete ([#15856](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15856) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Fixed streamed links and inline math showing raw `[text](url` or LaTeX and then rewrapping the paragraph when they close, in the terminal UI and native (TSP) terminals: they now render in their closed form while they stream ([#15864](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15864) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Paint-only overlays no longer swallow typing intended for the focused input beneath them ([#15793](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15793)).

name: v1.3.0
body:
### New Features

- **Choose where `/share` uploads**: `sessionShareDestination` selects `auto`, `gist`, or `radius`. See [Sessions and context](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#sessions-and-context) and [Export or share a session](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/sessions.md#export-or-share-a-session).
- **Cache-preserving thinking level changes on OpenAI GPT-6**: changing the thinking level mid-session with an API key keeps the prompt cache.
- **Kimi Code over Chat Completions**: tools added mid-conversation no longer invalidate the prompt cache. `models.json` base URL overrides must now include `/v1`. See [Providers](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md).
- **Clean model switching**: thinking from a previous model is dropped instead of being shown to the new model as text.
- **Resumed sessions keep their active tools**: `--tools +name`/`-name` applies on top of them. See [Tools](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#tools).

### Added

- Changing the thinking level mid-session on OpenAI GPT-6 models (API key) now keeps the prompt cache ([#10853](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10853))
- Added the `sessionShareDestination` setting to choose automatic, GitHub gist, or Radius uploads for `/share` ([#10870](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10870) by [@vegarsti](https://github.com/vegarsti))

### Changed

- Changed the `kimi-coding` provider to use OpenAI Chat Completions at `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1`, the protocol used by the official Kimi Code client. K3, K3-256K, and Kimi For Coding now accept tools added mid-conversation without invalidating the prompt cache. `models.json` overrides of the `kimi-coding` base URL must now include `/v1` ([#10720](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10720))
- Changed model switching to drop thinking blocks from earlier assistant messages produced by a different model, instead of sending them as plain text. The new model previously saw the old model's reasoning as part of its replies and could start writing its own reasoning into the visible answer ([#10995](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10995))

### Fixed

- Pinned internal Pi dependencies to exact release versions to prevent fresh installs from mixing incompatible packages ([#10865](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10865))
- Fixed resumed sessions dropping tools activated during the session. Resume now restores the session's active tools, with `--tools +name`/`-name` entries applied to them, unless `--tools` with tool names, `--no-tools`, or `--no-builtin-tools` selects tools explicitly ([#10785](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10785))
- Fixed stopping a codemode script or reaching its deadline waiting for a non-interruptible built-in to return on Bun ([#10748](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10748))
- Fixed repeated codemode timeouts or aborts accumulating surviving workers; admission now limits live workers to two across sessions, counting cancelled workers until actual exit ([#10748](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10748))
- Fixed `--model` choosing a provider by catalog order when several providers offer the match; Pi now prefers the provider with credentials and otherwise reports the ambiguity. `--models` and `enabledModels` add a model for each provider that offers it and warn about the ambiguity ([#10160](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10160))
- Fixed `read` line-range labels for numeric-string or null arguments in the TUI, session tree, HTML exports, and examples ([#9887](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9887))
- Fixed the Nix flake build failing when a provider switched APIs: the model catalog pin is now refreshed from the newest published catalog when its model API groups differ, and releases pin the newest catalog and build with it before tagging ([#10985](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10985))
- Fixed the Nix package putting its Node.js first on `PATH`, which made bash tool shells use Pi's Node instead of the user's `node`/`npm`. Pi's Node is now only a fallback ([#10519](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10519))
- Fixed prompt templates dropping empty quoted arguments (`""` or `''`), which shifted later positional arguments and prevented positional defaults from applying ([#10867](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10867))
- Fixed the Nix package build failing in its install check because it still expected chord and esbuild, which Pi no longer depends on
- Fixed tool-call argument parsing dropping fields when a string contains an invalid `\u` escape such as `\usepackage` ([#10868](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10868))
- Fixed Anthropic and Bedrock Claude requests failing with a 400 when an error tool result contains images; the images are now sent after the tool results of the turn, so the model still sees them ([#10794](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10794))
- Fixed OpenCode Go Gemini models failing with a 404 by moving OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go to the `opencode.ai/inference` endpoints, and added Google Generative AI support to the OpenCode Go provider
- Fixed OpenCode Go MiniMax M2.7 failing with "Model does not support this protocol" by using the Anthropic Messages API
- Fixed automatic retry not triggering for gateway `Unable to forward upstream stream` errors ([#10920](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10920))
- Fixed automatic retry not triggering for `The service is temporarily unavailable` errors, which also made compaction fail on the first attempt ([#10965](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10965))
- Fixed OpenAI-compatible responses showing thinking after the answer when a proxy such as LiteLLM sends reasoning and content in the same stream chunk ([#10926](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10926))
- Fixed Gemini 4 Argon requests on Google Vertex failing with "Thinking budget is not supported", and its thinking level being ignored on the Gemini API ([#10890](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10890))
- Fixed Xiaomi MiMo models failing with a 400 at the `minimal` thinking level; they now expose only the `off` and `high` levels ([#10818](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10818))
- Fixed `openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol` using a 272K context window instead of the 500K window Codex now provides ([#10840](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10840))
- Fixed tool calls whose final arguments are malformed JSON silently running with only the fields parsed before the error; they now fail validation and show the model the raw arguments it sent ([#10897](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10897))
- Fixed Claude Haiku 5.5 and Claude Opus 5 not supporting the `off` thinking level ([#10753](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10753))
- Fixed `done()` of an extension's `ctx.ui.custom({ overlay: true })` closing the topmost overlay instead of its own, which left the finished overlay on screen and another extension's dialog unresolved ([#10648](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10648), [#10999](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10999) by [@masonc15](https://github.com/masonc15))

name: v3.23.1 — Write-scope guard repairs, RFC 4180 CSV reading in sr-screener, and Gemini 4 Argon as a provisional verifier
body:
> **Repairs and model currency; no new skill, and no accuracy or performance claim:** v3.23.1 closes two write-scope guard paths that let writes through without a check, one for plugin-dispatched agents and one for Windows `timeout.exe` (#972), and the docs now state where the fence engages (#974). `sr-screener` reads CSV exports by RFC 4180 quoting instead of quote rules guessed from a sample (#979). Gemini 4 Argon is listed as a provisional Google verifier and the recommended Google id; `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` stays validated (#980). The routing core states that a mid-message `[direct-mode]` token is not the escape hatch (#892); in a smoke test on a plugin install, Claude Fable 5.1 still honored the token in 3 of 6 sessions (6 of 6 before), so the acceptance rule is not met and #892 stays open. Smaller lint and Windows repairs come from outside contributors (#956, #963, #965, #977), and `THIRD_PARTY.md` lists md-to-word (#969).

### Changed

- **Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`) is listed as a provisional Google verifier and becomes the recommended Google id (#980).** Google released it on 2026-10-13. `shared/cross_model_verification.md` adds it to the supported-model table and to the `provisional` branch of `id_status`, with a note on the provider facts that touch the Gemini call pattern: Search grounding is supported, sampling parameters are ignored, and `thinking_level` is left at the provider default. `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` keeps its validated status as the previous generation. The SETUP examples (en / zh-TW) and the `.claude/CLAUDE.md` summary follow. No smoke or bakeoff run is claimed; `scripts/cross_model_smoke_test.sh` covers the OpenAI route only, so the provisional and unlisted notices for a `gemini-*` id no longer point to it, and § Promotion Bakeoff marks the entry gate for a Gemini candidate as pending until a Gemini smoke script ships.

- **The routing core says that a mid-message `[direct-mode]` token is not the escape hatch (#892).** The rule was only in `shared/references/intent_clarification_protocol.md`, which a plugin-install session cannot read. One sentence joins Step 0 of `shared/references/routing_core.md` and its six copies; the `academic-pipeline/SKILL.md` content lock is updated. Measured on Claude Code 2.1.296 with the #133 fixtures (smoke test, one session per cell except fixture 06): on a plugin install, Claude Fable 5.1 honored the mid-message token in 6 of 6 sessions before the change and 3 of 6 after it, so the acceptance rule fixed before the run is not met and #892 stays open. All 21 fixtures ran in both installs on both models, and fixtures 13-21 ran for the first time; fixture 16 failed on Claude Opus 5.5 in the plugin install (#960), and the other single-cell failures and scoring readings are in the log. Results are in `tests/fixtures/issue_133_routing/CALIBRATION_LOG.md`.

- **The documentation states where the write-scope fence actually engages (#973, #974).** The fence acts only when a `PreToolUse` payload names a Bucket A agent type, which happens for separately dispatched, named subagents. Roles that run inline in the main session carry no agent type and are not fenced. The coverage claims in the docs now say so, and captured hook payloads are pinned as test fixtures.

- **`THIRD_PARTY.md` lists md-to-word, a Markdown-to-DOCX typesetting companion for Stage 5 output (#969, contributed by @ls-open).** It is an out-of-tree project; ARS does not bundle or endorse it.

### Fixed

- **`sr-screener` reads a CSV export correctly when a doubled quote appears only after the first 5,000 characters (#979, reported by @paololimo).** `srlib.parse_csv` sniffed the whole dialect from that sample, and a sample with no doubled quote switched RFC 4180 quote doubling off. A later field holding a quoted term was then split: with commas the year was lost and the DOI or journal received abstract text; with semicolons the fields stayed in place but the abstract gained stray quotes. `parse_csv` now sniffs only the delimiter, reads quotes by RFC 4180 (`"` as the quote character, doubling on), and also accepts a space before a quoted field, which RFC 4180 does not define. The same review found three related misreads, now fixed: apostrophes in the sample could make `'` the quote character, a quote-free sample could split a later `, "a, b"` field, and a single-column export with semicolons in its titles was read as semicolon-delimited; a header record that the sniffed delimiter splits into fewer than two fields now means a single column. Six regression tests in `scripts/test_sr_screener_pipeline.py` cover these cases.

- **Two write-scope guard paths no longer let writes through unchecked (#972; #970 and #971 reported by @xihuheyi007).** Claude Code names a plugin-shipped agent `academic-research-skills:<agent>`, while the scope manifest keys the bare name, so the fence never engaged for plugin-dispatched Bucket A agents; the guard now strips this plugin's own prefix before the lookup (#971). `hooks/run_guard.sh` trusted any `timeout` on `PATH`; the Windows built-in `timeout.exe` rejects the GNU form, so no Python was found and every write passed. The launcher now probes `timeout` once per launch and otherwise uses its watchdog fallback (#970).

- **Lints reject a non-string `exception_reason` (#965 by @SID-6921, #977 by @daniyyell-dev).** `check_field_norm_severity.py` read a `null` reason as present through `str(None)` (#965). `check_surface_form_parity.py` treated an int, list, or bool reason as absent, so a stray typed reason on a non-exception item passed (#977).

- **Windows: the v3.6.6 A/B fixture-manifest reverse scan compares POSIX paths (#963, contributed by @SID-6921).** `str(Path)` renders `\` on Windows and missed the forward-slash manifest entries.

- **A test regex uses a raw string, removing an invalid-escape warning (#956, contributed by @SID-6921).** Test-only; no behavior change.

name: Reasonix CLI v2.42.0
body: CLI archives built from the Studio release [studio-v2.42.0](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.42.0).

name: Reasonix Studio v2.42.0
body:
本版本新增会话概览、从源文件夹更新技能、更新提醒、按模型填写价格、子代理乐观写入范围和从分支创建独立工作区副本，并修复停止卡住、后台任务状态、同仓库项目互相等待写入、压缩恢复和一批界面问题。

## 新增

- 「我的反馈」新增「账号关联」：登录后可手动把这台电脑关联到账号，随时解除；默认关闭、不改变额度，网页账号页之后据此显示反馈等级。关联 #13141。
- 会话右键菜单新增“从最近回复分叉”，会话还在执行时也能从最近一个已完成的回复分叉；旧回复下的分叉按钮执行中同样可用。关联 #13177。
- 新增：侧边栏会话右键菜单加入“自动命名”，一步生成并保存标题，无需先打开重命名，关联 #13195 fixed in #13199
- 新增：设置 › 会话折叠 › 思考过程新增「收起并预览首句」，收起的思考在同一行后面显示首句（超长以 … 截断）。默认不变。关联 #13212。
- 新增：网页版 Studio 页面开着不关、内核升级后，会提示“这个页面不是最新版”并给出刷新按钮，不再出现 n.filter 之类的报错，关联 #13213 fixed in #13218
- 新增：删除带有恢复副本的会话时，确认框可以选择“连同 N 份副本删除”，不用再一个一个删，关联 #13221 fixed in #13225
- 新增：文件窗口里可以用“用其他程序打开项目”菜单，在 VS Code、终端等已安装的程序中打开当前项目，关联 #13227
- 新增：内置浏览器的页签可以双击重命名，不再只能显示网址，关联 #13228 fixed in #13267
- 新增：Windows 上可以给「指定一个可执行文件」填写启动参数（例如 wsl.exe -d 发行版 -- /bin/bash），保存前带着参数实际运行验证，无法运行则不保存。关联 #13247。
- 新增：右侧文件窗口的工具栏加了“在系统文件管理器中显示此文件”按钮，不用再去文件列表里右键，关联 #13255
- 新增：回复反馈时可以附上截图（粘贴或选择，最多 3 张），只发给维护者，由维护者决定是否公开。关联 #13258。
- 新增：可以从选定的分支创建独立的工作区副本，指定的分支不存在时会明确提示。关联 #13271。
- 新增：设置里「子代理的写入范围」可开启乐观模式（默认关闭）：没有声明 write_paths 的子代理不再占住整个工作区，可与主会话并发写。关联 #13274。
- 新增：连接编辑器里可以按模型填写每百万 token 的价格（输入、输出、缓存命中、货币），没价格的模型在用量里仍显示「未知」。关联 #13276。
- 新增：设置 → 版本里的“更新方式”。默认“手动”不做后台联网；选“提醒”后每天查一次版本目录，有新版本时设置图标出现小点。两种方式都不下载、不安装、不重启。关联 #13291。
- 新增：点击输入框下的“缓存”数字打开会话概览：请求、Token、缓存命中、工作时长、费用及按来源明细，各数字旁写明口径，费用不完整时只给下限。关联 #13297。
- 新增：会话概览里加上“上下文窗口”：已使用、容量、各类占比与自动压缩线，标明是下一次请求的当前值而非累计，可直达上下文详情。关联 #13297。
- 新增：技能列表会标出从某个文件夹安装的技能副本与来源文件夹是否一致（来源有更新、副本被改过、两边都改过、来源不见了）。关联 #13311。
- 新增：技能列表里，从本机文件夹复制安装的技能在来源有变化时可以“从源文件夹更新…”：先预览每个文件的改动（脚本需逐项展开），确认后才替换，失败会保留原副本。关联 #13311。

## 变更

- 侧栏底部的「发送反馈」现在用强调色加粗显示，更容易找到（不加动画；错误提示上的「报告此问题」和命令面板入口不变）。关联 #13048。
- MCP 服务器把耗时的工具调用作为任务返回时，现在会自动跟进到结果，不再返回空结果或要求任务扩展而报错。关联 #13108。
- MCP 任务超过工具超时后，会转成后台任务继续运行，可用 wait、bash_output 取结果、kill_shell 取消，不再直接超时失败。关联 #13108。
- 技能列表里，技能声明的许可（license）、运行要求（compatibility）和附加信息（metadata）现在可以展开查看；这些只是显示，不影响技能怎么运行。关联 #13110。
- 会话很多时侧栏刷新、改名更快：每次刷新不再逐个会话解析路径（Windows 上 2100 个会话约从 1.2 秒降到 0.4 秒）。关联 #13176。
- 用量页的「每日明细」现在最新一天排在最上面，不用再滚到底才能看到最近的数据。关联 #13179 fixed in #13182。
- 打开文件失败时按真实原因提示：只有文件确实不存在才说“找不到文件”；被软链接或权限拒绝的文件不再被误报为不存在。关联 #13180。
- 输入 / 弹出命令列表更快：补全命令名时不再每次读取插件包、模型和记忆数据，装了大量插件技能时尤其明显。关联 #13197。
- 输入 / 或 @ 时，上一个按键还没返回的补全请求会被取消，不再堆积占满连接。关联 #13197。
- 设置了提问超时后，提问卡片会显示“N 秒后自动跳过，点任意处保留”的倒计时，接管后消失；命令行界面同步显示。关联 #13210。
- 分支芯片区分“不是 Git 仓库”“Git 拒绝打开”“Git 没有及时响应”，并显示 Git 的原话，不再统一说不是仓库。关联 #13217。
- 启动时 Git 没及时响应不再让分支芯片整场会话都显示没有仓库：第一次读取时会再试一次。关联 #13217。
- 改进：配置文件无法读取导致设置没保存时，提示会指到「设置」里查看出错位置并修复，关联 #13220
- 优化：切换本地 Git 分支成功后立即使用切换结果更新界面，变更列表单独刷新，状态摘要的三项读取并行进行。关联 #12780。
- 改进：会话标签页里正在工作的会话状态点会呼吸闪动，已完成未读也直接由这个点表示（不再多出一个小点），关联 #13254
- 改进：带 write_paths 的子代理调用不允许的工具时，拒绝原因现在说明缘由和下一步（不要重试，改用文件工具或收尾汇报）。关联 #13269。
- 改进：压缩完成的卡片在折叠后仍占窗口很大一块时，会说明剩下的是什么（模型回复、工具输出、用户消息各多少，最大的一条是谁）。关联 #13284。
- 改进：更新下载卡住时，版本面板会说明“已重连 N 次”；重连仍无效则提示下载卡住，并给出重试或手动下载的办法。关联 #13291。
- 改变：输入框下的缓存百分比不再把服务商未区分缓存的输入算作未命中，与会话概览同一口径；这类输入多的会话读数更高。关联 #13297。
- 改进：对话右下角“回到顶部/底部”的按钮更淡更小，改为圆角方形、半透明浅底，不再是深色圆形。关联 #13303 fixed in #13310。
- 改进：给“额外可写文件夹”选择技能安装位置时，拒绝原因现在说明出路：把技能源文件夹用“登记”方式安装，并在源文件夹里修改。关联 #13311。

## 修复

- 修复超长会话里自动压缩反复放弃的问题：摘要模型没看到的改动不再被当成「摘要丢了全部改动」，由系统补记后正常折叠。关联 #13013。
- 修复：重命名或复制的文件在 Git 变更里的新增/删除行数现在能正确统计。关联 #13175 by @kevin9327。
- 修复鼠标移向状态栏里的上下文浮窗时它立刻消失、导致点不到「立即压缩」和「管理 MCP」的问题（浮窗与触发处之间的空隙现在会保持悬停）。关联 #13178 fixed in #13181。
- 修复：设置了壁纸时，标签栏下沿不再是一条生硬的横线，而是向下柔和渐隐，关联 #13194 fixed in #13198
- 修复：已过期的置顶记忆不再进入稳定前缀、不再遮蔽全局指引、也不再占用置顶字数预算。关联 #13201 by @chuiwenwei。
- 修复：关闭一个内核里已不存在的会话窗格时不再弹出 “no runtime r1”，按已关闭处理，关联 #13204 fixed in #13208
- 修复：电脑崩溃后会话检查点的最后一行写了一半时，不再丢掉其余完好的对话轮次。关联 #13241 by @chuiwenwei。
- 修复对话栏变窄时输入框工具栏（模型、思考强度、停下按钮）折成两行错位的问题：现在始终保持一行，放不下时模型名先缩略。关联 #13259。
- 修复：设置了独立的 REASONIX_HOME 时，配置编辑锁不再写到系统默认的 ~/.reasonix，保持独立目录自包含。关联 #13275。
- 修复：窗口截图的对话框已经关闭时，截图流程会安静停止，不再报“window is not defined”类错误。关联 #13285。
- 修复：「恢复旧会话」现在能导入 1.x 桌面版新存储（desktop-sessions-v5）里的会话，此前它们被悄悄跳过；无法使用的编号会列入“未导入”。关联 #13290 fixed in #13296。
- 修复：项目菜单里的“文件管理器”“终端”现在显示中文，且“用文件管理器打开”不再与“在文件管理器中显示”重复。关联 #13292 fixed in #13298。
- 修复：改动范围无法确认时，结束前的提示会说明检查解决不了它，要换用会报告路径的工具重做。关联 #13293。
- 修复：打开会话时，之前保存的压缩结果若因历史变化或模型/工作区不同而无法复用，现在会提示原因，不再悄悄改发完整历史。关联 #13295。
- 修复：Windows 上停止任务时，如果系统的 taskkill 卡住，整个“停止”不再被它无限期拖住：最多等 10 秒，之后直接结束主进程。关联 #13299。
- 修复：顶部的计划按钮不再停在标签行中间，而是靠右紧挨“辅助会话”。关联 #13302 fixed in #13307。
- 修复：停止后把同一句话再发一次，不再在待发队列里叠出多份；原来未生效的那条被重新排队，恢复后只会回答一次。关联 #13318。
- 修复：停止后台任务后，右下角的任务列表会立即刷新；对已在停止中的任务再点停止，会说明“已请求停止，进程还没退出”，不再误报“已经不在运行”。关联 #13319。
- 修复：从源文件夹更新技能后，记录写入失败会自动重试一次；仍失败时再点一次更新即可补上记录，技能不再被误判为“副本被改过”。关联 #13311。
- 修复：对话右下角“回到会话顶部/跳到最新”按钮一次点击直达两端；原来的“逐个展开块”跳法改为按住 Shift 点击。关联 #13326、#13229。
- 修复：会话概览里同一行的数字按同一高度对齐，不再因旁边格的脚注较长而下沉。关联 #13297。
- 修复：同一个 Git 仓库下的多个项目互相等待写入时，提示现在说明它们共用该仓库这一个写入域，并给出出路。关联 #13335。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@kevin9327、@chuiwenwei

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds a session overview, updating skills from their source folder, update notifications, per-model prices and an optimistic sub-agent write mode, and fixes stuck Stop, background-job state, projects in one repository waiting on each other and compaction recovery.

## New

- "My feedback" gains an "Account link": once signed in, link this computer yourself and unlink any time. Off by default, changes no limits. Refs #13141.
- New "Branch from the latest reply" in the session menu: a running conversation can branch from its latest finished reply, and older replies' branch buttons work mid-run. Refs #13177.
- Added: the sidebar session menu now has Auto name, which generates and saves a title in one step without opening Rename first, refs #13195 fixed in #13199
- Added: Settings › Conversation folding › Thinking gains "Folded, with first sentence", showing the first sentence after a folded thought (long ones end in …). Default unchanged. Refs #13212.
- Added: a hosted Studio page left open across an upgrade now says it is not the latest build and offers a refresh, instead of failing with errors like n.filter, refs #13213 fixed in #13218
- Added: deleting a conversation that has recovery copies now offers to delete the copies with it, instead of one by one, refs #13221 fixed in #13225
- Added: the file window has an "open the project in another program" menu (VS Code, terminal and the other programs installed here), refs #13227
- Added: built-in browser tabs can be renamed by double-clicking, instead of always showing the address, refs #13228 fixed in #13267
- Added: on Windows, "point at an executable" takes launcher arguments (for example wsl.exe -d <distro> -- /bin/bash), verified by running them before saving. Refs #13247.
- Added: the file window in the right sidebar has a "show this file in the system file manager" button in its toolbar, so you no longer need the file list right-click, refs #13255
- Added: replies to feedback can carry screenshots (paste or pick, up to 3); they go to the maintainers only, who decide whether to make them public. Refs #13258.
- Added: an isolated workspace copy can be created from a chosen branch, and an unknown branch is reported clearly. Refs #13271.
- Added: an optimistic mode for sub-agent write scope in Settings (off by default): a sub-agent with no write_paths no longer holds the whole workspace. Refs #13274.
- Added: the connection editor takes a per-model price (input, output, cache hit, currency); a model with no price still shows as unknown in usage. Refs #13276.
- Added: Settings, Version, "Update mode". Manual (default) does nothing in the background; Notify checks daily and dots the Settings icon. Neither downloads, installs or restarts. Refs #13291.
- Added: the cache figure under the composer opens a session overview: requests, tokens, cache hit, work time, cost, by source, each with its definition; incomplete cost shows a floor. Refs #13297.
- Added: the session overview shows the context window: used, capacity, share by kind and the fold line, stated as a current reading, with a way into the context details. Refs #13297.
- Added: the Skills list marks an installed skill copy that no longer matches the folder it came from: source changed, copy edited, both changed, or source gone. Refs #13311.
- Added: a skill copied from a local folder can be updated from it in the Skills list: preview each file change (scripts must be opened), confirm; a failure keeps the old copy. Refs #13311.

## Changed

- The sidebar footer's "Send feedback" is now bold in the accent colour so it is easier to find (no animation; other feedback entries unchanged). Refs #13048.
- MCP servers that answer a long tool call as a task are now followed to the result, instead of returning nothing or failing for lack of the tasks extension. Refs #13108.
- An MCP task that outruns the tool's timeout now continues as a background job you can wait on, read with bash_output or cancel with kill_shell, instead of failing on the timeout. Refs #13108.
- A skill's declared license, requirements (compatibility) and metadata can now be opened in the skills list; display only, nothing about how it runs changes. Refs #13110.
- With many sessions the sidebar refreshes and renames faster: a refresh no longer resolves every session's path (2100 sessions on Windows: about 1.2 s to 0.4 s). Refs #13176.
- The usage page's daily breakdown now lists the newest day first, so the latest figures are visible without scrolling to the bottom. Refs #13179 fixed in #13182.
- Opening a file that fails now says why: only a file that is not there is reported as missing, and one behind a refused link or a permission error is no longer called "not found". Refs #13180.
- Typing / opens the command list faster: completing a command name no longer reads plugin packages, models and memory on every keystroke, which matters most with many plugin skills. Refs #13197.
- While typing / or @, a completion request a newer keystroke has made stale is cancelled instead of piling up on the connection pool. Refs #13197.
- With an ask timeout set, the question card now counts down "skipped in N s, click anywhere to keep it" and stops once you take the question over; the terminal UI shows it too. Refs #13210.
- The branch chip tells "not a Git repository" from "Git refused to open it" and "Git did not respond", and shows Git's own words. Refs #13217.
- If Git does not answer when a session opens, the branch chip no longer says there is no repository for the whole session: the first read tries once more. Refs #13217.
- Improved: when a setting is not saved because the config file does not parse, the message now points to Settings, where the broken line is shown and can be repaired, refs #13220
- Improved: after a successful local Git branch switch, the UI uses the returned state at once and refreshes the change list on its own; the summary's three reads now overlap. Refs #12780.
- Improved: the session tab dot breathes while a session is working, and finished-but-unread is shown by that same dot (no extra small dot), refs #13254
- Improved: when a write_paths sub-agent calls a target it may not run, the refusal now says why and what to do next (do not retry; use file tools or report). Refs #13269.
- Improved: when a fold still leaves a large share of the window, its card says what the rest is made of and which single message is the largest. Refs #13284.
- Improved: when an update download goes quiet, the version panel says it reconnected N times, and if that fails says it got stuck, with a retry or manual installer. Refs #13291.
- Changed: the cache percentage under the composer no longer counts prompt the provider did not split as uncached, matching the overview; sessions with much of it read higher. Refs #13297.
- Improved: the jump-to-top/bottom buttons are lighter and smaller, rounded squares with a translucent pale fill instead of dark circles. Refs #13303 fixed in #13310.
- Improved: granting the installed-skills folder as a writable folder now explains the way forward: install the skill's source folder in register mode and edit it there. Refs #13311.

## Fixed

- Fixed auto-compaction repeatedly giving up in very long sessions: changes the summarizer never saw are no longer treated as lost by it. Refs #13013.
- Fixed: added and removed line counts are now correct for renamed and copied files in the Git changes. Refs #13175 by @kevin9327.
- Fixed the status-bar context card closing as the pointer moved toward it, which made "Compress now" and "Manage MCP" unreachable; the gap now keeps the hover. Refs #13178 fixed in #13181.
- Fixed: over a wallpaper the tab strip no longer ends on a hard line; it now fades softly into the conversation, refs #13194 fixed in #13198
- Fixed: an expired pinned memory no longer rides the stable prefix, shadows live global guidance, or consumes the pinned-character budget. Refs #13201 by @chuiwenwei.
- Fixed: closing a pane the kernel no longer holds no longer surfaces a raw "no runtime r1" error; it counts as closed, refs #13204 fixed in #13208
- Fixed: when a crash leaves the last line of a session checkpoint half-written, the intact turns before it are no longer lost. Refs #13241 by @chuiwenwei.
- Fixed the composer toolbar breaking into two misaligned lines when the conversation column is narrow: it stays on one line and the model name shortens first. Refs #13259.
- Fixed: with an isolated REASONIX_HOME, config edit locks no longer go to the default ~/.reasonix; the isolated home stays self-contained. Refs #13275.
- Fixed: the window capture now stops quietly when its dialog is already gone, instead of raising a "window is not defined" error. Refs #13285.
- Fixed: "Recover older sessions" now imports 1.x desktop (desktop-sessions-v5) conversations, which were skipped silently; an unusable id is listed as skipped. Refs #13290 fixed in #13296.
- Fixed: the project menu now shows "File manager" and "Terminal" in your language, and no longer lists the file manager twice. Refs #13292 fixed in #13298.
- Fixed: when a change's extent is unknown, the end-of-turn prompt now says a check cannot settle it and to redo it with a path-reporting tool. Refs #13293.
- Fixed: when a saved compaction cannot be reused on opening a session, a notice now says why instead of silently sending the full history. Refs #13295.
- Fixed: on Windows a hung taskkill no longer holds a Stop forever; it is given 10 seconds, after which the main process is ended directly. Refs #13299.
- Fixed: the plan button in the tab row now sits at the right edge beside the side-question toggle instead of floating mid-row. Fixes #13302 fixed in #13307.
- Fixed: after a stop, sending the same words again no longer stacks copies in the held queue; the steer that did not apply is requeued, so once released it is answered once. Refs #13318.
- Fixed: after stopping a background job the task list refreshes at once, and stopping one already shutting down says so instead of claiming it is not running. Refs #13319.
- Fixed: a failed record write after a skill update is retried once; if it still fails, updating again repairs the record instead of leaving the skill marked edited. Refs #13311.

name: ctx7@0.7.0
body:
### Minor Changes

- f54b372: Tell users when their Context7 session has expired instead of silently continuing without an account. If the server rejects the stored refresh token, the CLI clears the dead credentials. In a terminal it asks "Your Context7 session has expired. Sign in again now? (Y/n)" and, on yes, signs you in and continues the command. In scripts, agents, CI or with `--json` it never prompts; it prints a one-line notice to stderr and continues anonymously. Network errors, rate limits and server errors keep the credentials so the next command retries.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.15

`0.21.15` is a patch release for the frozen range `v0.21.14..38bbaab4c818cadcfe2b69de22c52cf56e670ca0` (6 commits, 39 files, +2,199/−152).

The v0.21.14 baseline already includes the single-footer correction from PR #3805 by @Yeachan-Heo.

## Highlights

- **Native subagent completion and nested lifecycle routing (#3798, #3809):** record native `SubagentStop` completion events and keep nested children associated with their tracked parent, so completion routing and deduplication continue to work through nested native subagents.
- **Bounded startup context (#3808):** avoid delivering memory already present in session instructions and cap Wiki startup context at 3,500 characters while retaining complete lines and retrieval guidance.
- **Deterministic collector timing tests (#3811):** inject a clock and replace wall-clock sleeps with exact latency assertions.

name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.1
body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Faster, steadier Gateway:** chat turns, session lists, startup, and idle Gateways do far less SQLite and main-thread work, with more database work moved onto worker threads, so busy hosts and large agent fleets stay responsive. (#167965, #168002, #168093, #169005, #169164, #171685, #170151, #169871, #168649, #170612, #171371, #171805, #168992, #169543) Thanks @obviyus, @609NFT, @Leon-SK668, @chelsealong, @RomneyDa, and @joshavant.
- **Updates that finish:** upgrades from 2026.10.1 and earlier betas complete, busy Gateways and slow Doctor steps no longer refuse or roll back a good update, failed updates no longer leave a half-installed version, and macOS, Windows, and Bun installs recover from their platform-specific failures. (#168849, #172249, #172196, #172151, #172247, #171101, #170519, #172640, #171936, #170940, #171077, #172494) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @giulianoaccorsi, @AntaresGG, @stop-time, @davidcittadini, and @SBC2016.
- **Restart-safe replies:** interrupted and unfinished replies resume after a Gateway restart, and watched child results, queued turns, accepted agent updates, and operator tasks survive restarts instead of disappearing. (#172234, #172412, #169489, #171717, #170697, #170858, #170384, #172356, #172023) Thanks @jeanmonet.
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from the session menu, organize cloud environments by repository with environment recipes and verified Node toolchains, and see snapshot progress while sessions start before the first snapshot finishes uploading. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729)
- **Local Gateway in the desktop apps:** the Windows desktop app and fresh Tauri installs can run a local Gateway, fresh macOS installs start in guided dashboard setup, and first-run setup chooses inference automatically. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169628)
- **New models:** Gemini 4 Argon becomes the default Gemini model alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and xAI Imagine Image 2.0 arrive, Meta models run through Muse Code, and pickers stop offering retired models. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170487, #171526, #171879) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, and @obviyus.
- **Newer Apple platforms required:** OpenClaw now requires macOS 26.2, iOS 26.2, and Safari 26.2 or newer. (#168595)

### Changes

- **Apple platform requirement:** require macOS, iOS, and Safari 26.2 or newer for the native apps and Control UI. (#168595)
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from session menus, organize cloud environments by repository, support repository environment recipes with verified Node toolchains, save suggested cloud profiles on first use, show snapshot startup progress, start sessions while the first snapshot uploads, ready workers for empty-workspace sessions, report slow dispatch phases, and keep cloud setup secrets behind scoped egress grants. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729, #170929, #171749, #171073, #170810) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Desktop apps and first run:** support local Gateways in the Windows desktop app, start fresh Tauri installs with a local Gateway, start fresh macOS installs in guided dashboard setup, guide missing native permissions in chat, and choose inference automatically during first-run setup. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169635, #169628)
- **Local setup:** offer optional memory embedding setup, add managed llama.cpp OCR and vision setup, and allow non-interactive llama.cpp embedding-only setup. (#163693, #148193, #170153) Thanks @PollyBot13, @duyufansh2008, and @dh-js.

body:
## 2026.10.4

### Highlights

- The Gateway keeps running after the computer sleeps or the system clock jumps, instead of restarting itself because its ownership heartbeat looked stale. (#170790) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway shutdown and restart no longer hang on a stalled transcript worker or in-flight session lifecycle events. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Tlon group DMs no longer treat other participants as the owner, closing an owner-impersonation path. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Headless browser pages keep responding to clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Manual `/compact` settles the active run before compacting instead of aborting it and dropping the pending request. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.

### Changes

- Stability patch for 2026.10.3 with no new features or configuration changes. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Gateway: stays responsive during long reply-tagged streams, and long replies that quote tool-call XML no longer re-parse Markdown on every token. (#166782, #171573) Thanks @boeingchoco.
- Gateway: blocked durable context-engine turns are logged once instead of on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- Control UI: delayed application heartbeats no longer force a reconnect. (#171253)
- Gateway: recover state ownership after sleep and wall-clock changes, and allow `openclaw gateway restart` from verified external macOS terminals. (#170790, #170354) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: bound transcript-worker shutdown waits and wait for session lifecycle publication during shutdown. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Gateway: start enabled standalone plugin files with the Gateway, and keep worker heap limits enforced when the managed service sets a process-wide heap flag. (#171330, #166581) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, and @obviyus.
- Agents: launched plugin turns no longer fail with writer-claim errors, and Claude CLI sessions no longer fork history across message routes. (#170077, #167241) Thanks @cmatrx0.

name: 0.164.0-alpha.1
body: Release 0.164.0-alpha.1

## New Features

- Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
- Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
- Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)
- Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
- Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
- Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

## Bug Fixes

- Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
- The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
- Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
- On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
- Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
- `codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

## Documentation

- Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
- Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

## Chores

- Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
- Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

name: v5.1.34
body:
**`oracle`, `momus` and `plan-reviewer` fall back to Argon before the previous pro model.** In all three chains, Argon at high thinking (Google, Vertex or OpenCode) now sits directly ahead of the previous pro rung, which stays in place for Copilot and for engine pins that do not serve Argon yet. The GPT heads keep first place: on 8 consult and plan-review tasks graded blind, Argon beat the previous pro model in all 16 judgments but did not beat the current GPT heads on correctness, and its median answer took 57 s against 15 s. Telemetry now names the Qwen 3.7 Plus rung of `explore` and `librarian` instead of reporting it as `custom`. ([#10180](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10180), [#10263](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10263))

**`omo login`, `omo logout` and `omo whoami` are switched off until OmO accounts open.** OmO accounts aren't open to everyone yet. On every launcher (the npm `omo`, the compiled `omo` binary and the OpenCode-edition CLI), running `omo login`, `omo logout` or `omo whoami`, with any options including `--help`, prints "OmO accounts aren't available yet." and exits 1 without contacting the service or touching the OS credential store. They are gone from the OpenCode-edition CLI's `--help` command list, where `help login`, `help logout` and `help whoami` refuse the same way, and from the short command list `omo --help` prints when the engine can't start. Signing in to model providers (`/login`, `omo mcp oauth login`) works as before. ([#10262](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10262), [#10264](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10264))

**`omo account keys` gives each machine its own device identity and keeps its private keys off the process list.** `omo account keys init` now generates a random device id per machine and stores it with the keys, where every CLI install used to share the id `cli`. `OMO_DEVICE_NAME` no longer sets the id. On macOS without `Bun.secrets`, the Keychain write passes the key record to `security -i` on stdin; before, it went on the command line, where other processes could read it. The memory sync device keyring signs only RFC 8785 canonical JSON, checked by a full parse and re-serialization. It gains a snapshot signing purpose, and it opens epoch key wraps with the sync-design §8.1 HPKE `info` and associated data, so a wrap moved to another account, epoch or device does not open. Nothing syncs yet. ([#10194](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10194))

**Internal: an authenticated XPC transport for the desktop engine, not used yet.** A hidden `--xpc-agent` mode serves the existing JSON-RPC over XPC. It accepts only a verified signed controller, gives each connection its own session, and carries no requests over the public discovery channel. No shipped client selects it. ([#10207](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10207), [#10220](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10220))

**Full access no longer stops on permission prompts, and every session on a shared host can sign in the same way (senpi 2026.10.16).** Under the `full-access` preset a configured `ask` rule no longer raises a prompt, while a configured `deny` still refuses and now names the rule and the settings layer it came from. A session opened on the shared task host lists the same sign-in options as a standalone one, so an OAuth provider that an extension registers is no longer missing there. Claude subscription sessions on 1M-window models such as Opus 5.5 no longer fail with "Prompt is too long" past 200k tokens, sessions sharing one credential pool no longer fail with "Credential store is busy", and opening the TUI or running `/new` without sending a message no longer leaves an empty session in `/resume`. The built-in Anthropic default is Opus 5.5 and the Xiaomi default is MiMo V2.6 Pro, used only when no model is saved or passed ([senpi v2026.10.16](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.16), [#10260](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10260))

**A background child aborted by another client no longer reports a failure.** Another client's user abort on a shared child session now ends that task as `interrupted` with whatever partial answer it had produced, instead of `error`: `task_output` keeps the partial text, no failure notification fires, and the task stays resumable with `task_send`. The parent's own abort still ends the task as `cancelled`, and provider or host-system aborts keep the failure classification ([#10095](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10095)).

**Interrupted background tasks recover without crash warnings.** Tasks that cannot reconnect resume automatically from their saved conversation and launch instructions within the existing retry budget. If recovery still fails, one notice names the task and its handle, explains why, and gives the corrective action for that cause; technical crash details stay in logs. Finished tasks with undelivered queued messages ask you to resend those messages rather than repeat finished work. Recovery completions retain partial output, the transcript tail, and a file pointer for large results ([#10023](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10023), [#10031](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10031)).

**ulw-research reports always carry visuals.** The final-report phase now requires at least one chart drawn from the run's own data, a diagram wherever structure matters, and the topic's screenshots or video with attribution, every one captioned and given alt text. A new playbook says which visual fits which finding and how to render it: data charts with live text, Mermaid diagrams themed to the report, PlotNeuralNet for paper-style reports that describe a model's architecture, and Andrej Karpathy's tips on diagrams, HTML pages and explainer videos. The report checker now flags a report with no rendered visual and an image with no alt text; an empty alt counts as decorative only when the image is also marked `role="presentation"` or `aria-hidden`. ([#10258](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10258), [#10261](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10261))
