body:
# Cua Driver 0.36.0

This release makes background work on macOS more reliable. The driver does more without touching your windows, your keyboard focus or your pointer.

## What's new

- **Background typing into LibreOffice.** Documents and spreadsheets take keystrokes while you work in another app.
- **Chrome's first read of a background window now includes the page.** You no longer get an empty tree on the first call.
- **Background drag.** Drags work in native apps and on web pages. Electron windows refuse a background drag in this release and offer a foreground drag instead.
- **Background menu commands.** Menu and format controls work without bringing the app forward.
- **Reading pages on another Space.** You can read a page without switching Spaces.
- **Dropdowns no longer raise the window.**
- **No focus bounce after background clicks.** Your app keeps focus.
- **A clear error when you run the bare binary.** The driver now says so and asks you to run the app bundle (CuaDriver.app), which it needs for a WindowServer connection. `health_report` has a new `windowserver_connection` check.
- **Updated skill guidance** for agents.

## Changes

### Features

- publish isolated browser session lifetime in browser_prepare. ([#5183](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5183)) Thanks @iflaqbhat.
- background drag on macOS (CUA-1207). ([#5309](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5309))

### Fixes

- advertise coordinate scrolling support. ([#5149](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5149)) Thanks @Iflaqbhat; reported by @amplogik.
- let CUA_LOG=info and debug raise the log level. ([#5173](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5173)) Thanks @Ed-Key.
- type long Linux text in spare-keycode batches. ([#5168](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5168)) Thanks @CMGS.
- stop worker and embedded processes launching Orca on GNOME. ([#5179](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5179)) Thanks @methanoya.
- drain autoreleased objects on SCK capture workers. ([#5170](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5170)) Thanks @Irfanwani.
- report every layer when list_windows is given a pid. ([#5162](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5162)) Thanks @bitomule.
- wait for the client before restoring a borrowed keycode. ([#5172](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5172)) Thanks @CMGS.
- build macOS fixtures for the host architecture. ([#5202](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5202)) Thanks @loonghao.
- list window rows in list_windows text content. ([#5211](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5211)) Thanks @Irfanwani.
- print actionable PATH install hints. ([#5219](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5219)) Thanks @Iflaqbhat.
- report actual browser delivery mode in public results. ([#5222](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5222))
- refuse unconfirmed macOS Electron scrolls. ([#5251](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5251)) Thanks @SDSLeon.
- honor --pid-file in cua-driver status. ([#5246](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5246)) Thanks @methanoya.
- skip web content during Chrome consent scans. ([#5216](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5216)) Thanks @Iflaqbhat.
- report Linux and Windows permissions status instead of "not granted". ([#5237](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5237)) Thanks @RitikaxG.
- say why a Windows desktop can't be captured (locked, RDP disconnected) (CUA-1727). ([#5266](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5266))
- stop a batched text before rebinding keycodes the client has not confirmed reading. ([#5244](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5244)) Thanks @CMGS.
- background keyboard into editor surfaces and multi-window apps (CUA-1767). ([#5306](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5306))
- background menu/format controls and page reads on another Space (CUA-1768, CUA-1769). ([#5307](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5307))
- make the addressed LibreOffice window key without activating (CUA-1767). ([#5319](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5319))
- wait for Chrome web content on first read; point background browser_prepare refusals to the AX route (CUA-1766). ([#5305](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5305))
- refuse background drags in Electron windows and fix the AppKit drag cell. ([#5335](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5335))
- stop background actions from raising Chrome or re-activating the user's app (CUA-1309, CUA-1791). ([#5334](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5334))
- resolve launch_app to the app window, not a launcher splash. ([#5342](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5342)) Thanks @abonneth.
- fail loudly when the unbundled daemon has no WindowServer connection (CUA-1777). ([#5333](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5333))
- keep the current tab's page out of the Chrome setup proof. ([#5343](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5343)) Thanks @abonneth.

## Contributors

Thanks to @abonneth, @amplogik, @bitomule, @CMGS, @Ed-Key, @Iflaqbhat, @Irfanwani, @loonghao, @methanoya, @RitikaxG, @SDSLeon for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.

name: v1.4.227
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Native chats have their own permission mode.** Choose permissions for each new Claude or Codex chat from Settings → Chat → Behavior; existing chats keep the mode they were already using, and changing models no longer resets it.
- **Native chat sessions are easier to continue.** You can resume large terminal conversations in a new native chat, recover chats whose only work ran in the background after a restart, and see every supported chat provider accurately in Session History.
- **Claude accounts and Codex chat setup are smoother.** Claude accounts again use separate folders, the sign-in link can be copied, Codex chats require version 0.136.0 or later, and Codex Ultrafast is available as a speed choice.
- **Browser automation gives your keyboard back reliably.** Agent browser commands target the intended page, and browser popups behave more like Chrome.
- **Also:** worktree cleanup is safer, read macOS notifications disappear from Notification Center, long chats load better on phones, and cold session-history reads avoid unnecessary reindexing.

---

## Product experience

### UI / workspace

*Safer worktree cleanup, tidier macOS notifications and small translation cleanup.*
* fix(worktrees): never delete a folder git no longer tracks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25075
* fix(notifications): remove read macOS notifications from Notification Center by pane thread by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28425
* fix(i18n): drop chat-mode keys removed from en.json in #28113 by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28131

### Orchestration

*Retries no longer leave failed worker starts piling up as live agents.*
* fix(orchestration): stop retried failed worker starts from piling up live agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27795

### Agents / native chat

*Each Claude and Codex chat keeps its own permission mode, chats are easier to resume and manage, Claude accounts return with safer sign-in, and chat settings and model handling are more consistent.*
* feat(native-chat): each Claude/Codex chat gets its own permission mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26116
* fix(native-chat): chats from before permission modes keep the mode they were running with by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28099
* fix(native-chat): seed the chat permission default from Claude's and Codex's own arguments by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28100
* feat(settings): move Permissions for new chats into the Chat page's Behavior section by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28212
* fix(native-chat): store a chat's permission mode on its own, so a model pick can't reset it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28268
* feat(native-chat): require Codex 0.136.0 for chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26684
* feat(native-chat): offer Codex Ultrafast as a speed choice by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26962
* Re-land Claude per-account folders (#24434, #26405) with the upgrade and proxy fixes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26801
* Add "Copy sign-in link instead" for Claude accounts (STA-9912) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26990
* fix(native-chat): offer resume after restart for chats whose only work was in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27167
* fix(native-chat): resume large terminal conversations in a new native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29056
* Terminal header button: Resume in New Native Chat replaces Show chat view by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27184
* fix(tab-bar): offer Resume in New Native Chat only while the tab's agent is running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27520
* Session History shows OpenCode, Grok, OMP and Pi chats as chats and refuses a second terminal writer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27183
* Session History: resume folder workspace chats in their own folder by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27209
* Resume dialog: show a finished resume as a result, not a picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27732
* Save a new chat's first message during create by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26332
* fix(native-chat): settle a reply cut off by a server restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26460
* Open a chat visual in its own tab instead of the sidebar by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26728
* Let a Codex chat stop a command it left running in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26780
* fix(native-chat): preserve running subagent rows in long chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26798
* A new Pi chat names the model it will run on its first frame by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26821
* Keep Chat UI users with a Terminal default on the terminal, with a chat mode switch in the upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26915
* Floating-workspace chats of every native-chat agent keep links in the folder they started in by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26981
* Every agent reports its learned default model once, when a chat starts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26982
* Let a Grok chat list and stop the commands it left running in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27022
* Let a Codex chat stop a sub-agent from the background-tasks strip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27026
* fix(native-chat): a new chat's model and effort pickers match their first frame before the agent starts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27031
* Native chat: every agent launches through one composed launch path by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27204
* Edit agent launch settings on the workspace host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26479
* One shared subagent tracker for Claude, Codex and Grok chat rows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27228
* Native chat: read one saved row per subagent (part 1 of 2) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27914
* feat(chat): host writes one saved row per subagent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27947
* feat(settings): move Chat UI's chat settings from Experimental to the Chat page by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28050
* fix(tab-bar): native chat tabs show their recorded provider, not one guessed from the title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28082
* Replace chat upgrade switch with primary Enable Now button by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28113
* Make Enable Now the full-width action in the chat upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28199

### Remote server / SSH

*Paired devices are identified by their device ID instead of a credential.*
* native chat: identify a paired device by its device id, never its credential by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26777

### Browser

*Popups follow Chrome’s behavior more closely, while agent browser actions stay focused on the intended page and return the keyboard when they finish.*
